name: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze
summary: Across the bridge from Auberdine, Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze watches over Darkshore's coast. From an upper floor, she tracks dangers in the wilderness and guides travelers toward them.

sections.title: A Vigilant Eye in Auberdine
sections.body: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze directs Auberdine's defenses from across the bridge. Other Sentinels patrol Darkshore's coast and woodlands, while she keeps watch from the upper floor of a building northeast of the town inn. She stays alert for disturbances across the region. Her directions send travelers as far north as the Tower of Althalaxx, so threats in the shadows do not take Auberdine by surprise.

faq.q: Where can I find Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze?
faq.answer: Cross the small bridge northeast of Auberdine's inn, then go to the second floor of the building there. Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is on duty inside.

faq.q: What is her duty in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze helps guard Auberdine by watching for dangers across Darkshore. She directs scouts and adventurers toward distant outposts and strange threats, including the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: Does she have family among the night elves?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded about Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze's kin. In Auberdine, she watches over the town and guides travelers toward the Tower of Althalaxx.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the Sentinels' watchful discipline at northern Kalimdor outposts such as Auberdine.
As an Alliance traveler from Teldrassil, you can look to Sentinel Starbreeze for directions to dangers deeper in Darkshore.
